source: Cloud closure assignment, 2026-11-06 (A3 evidence completeness + I2 rules 2, 3, 4b)
context: The 2026-11-04 cloud continuation wrote its raw artifacts to the untracked .phase2-cloud directory on a sandbox that no longer exists. The originals listed in final-2026-11-05/evidence-availability.json are therefore unrecoverable. Per the assignment, each named artifact was replaced by reproducing only the specific test needed, on a fresh cloud sandbox, at HEAD 3e40a2d (main-full-dev), with committed scripts, manifests, source identities, execution metadata and logs. The retained Windows artifacts are untouched.

parserCorrection: The 2026-11-06 run found and fixed a field-offset defect in the i2r4 snapshot parser (id read as self_size, type index read as name); the committed script now derives every index from the snapshot's own meta, and the correction plus the prior wrong values are disclosed inside memory-attribution/i2r4-linux-result.json.
disposition: A3's named gaps are closed by dated replacement evidence that re-runs reproducibly from committed scripts. The original 2026-11-04 raw files remain lost with their sandbox; the historical record keeps their dated results and manifests. The Windows gate-box reruns named in the I2 ledger remain the owner's environment.
